speck.definition:
n. a very small spot
v. produce specks in or on
speck.translation:
n. 斑点, 有斑点的东西, 污点, 缺点, 微粒, 肥肉
vt. 使有斑点

specked.definition:
v produce specks in or on
s having a pattern of dots
specked.translation: a. 有斑点的, 有疵痕的

specking.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Speck

speckle.translation:
n. 小的斑点, 亮斑, 斑
vt. 弄上斑点, 弄成斑纹, 点缀

speckle effect.translation: [计] 斑点效应, 斑纹效应

speckle interferometry.translation: 斑纹干涉测量, 散斑干涉测量术

speckled.definition:
v produce a mottled effect
v mark with small spots
s having a pattern of dots

speckled trout.translation:
na. 斑鲑
[网络] 斑点鳟；斑鳟；斑点鳟鱼

speckles.definition:
n a small contrasting part of something
v produce a mottled effect
v mark with small spots
speckles.translation: n. （皮肤、羽毛、蛋壳等上的）斑点, 色斑( speckle的名词复数 )

speckless.definition:
n a small contrasting part of something
v produce a mottled effect
v mark with small spots
s completely neat and clean

speckling.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Speckle
speckling.translation: v. （皮肤、羽毛、蛋壳等上的）斑点, 色斑( speckle的现在分词 )

specklings.definition:
plural of speckling
p. pr. & vb. n. of Speckle
specklings.translation: (speckling 的复数) v. （皮肤、羽毛、蛋壳等上的）斑点, 色斑( speckle的现在分词 )

specks.definition:
n a very small spot
n (nontechnical usage) a tiny piece of anything
n a slight but appreciable amount
v produce specks in or on

specktioneer.translation: n. (捕鲸船上的)捕鲸主炮手

specky.translation: a. 有斑点的,有瑕疵的
